questions.qtext: In the final simplex tableau of linear programming problem (LPP), it is found that zj - cj = 0 for at least one non-basic variable. Which of the following conclusions is correct?

options.text: The solution is optimal and unique.
Three exists at least one alternate optimal solution.

questions.solution:
(c)
When zj - cj = 0, for a non-basic variable in the final tableau, it indicates the possibility of introducing this variable into the basis without changing the optimal value, thus leading to another optimal solution.

questions.qtext: In the program evaluation and review technique (PERT), the time duration of an activity is assumed to follow which of the following probability distributions?
questions.solution:
(c)
PERT models activity durations using a Beta distribution because it can be shaped to reflect
skewness in time estimates using three parameters : Optimistic, most likely, and pessimistic times.

questions.qtext: In reference to Kendall’s notations (a | b | c = d | e | f ) used for queuing theory, which of the following statement is correct?
questions.solution:
(c)
In Kendall's notation,
'a' represents arrival distribution.
'b' represents diparture (or service time) distribution.
'c' represents number of servers in the system.
'd' represents service discipline.
'e' represents maximum number of customers allowed in the system.
'f' represents calling source or population.

questions.qtext: A basic feasible solution to a m × n transportation problem is said to be non-degenerate if

options.text: Total number of non-negative allocations is exactly equal to sum of number of sources and destinations.
Total number of non-negative allocations is one less than the sum of number of sources and destinations.
The allocations are in independent positions.
The allocations are in dependent positions.

questions.solution:
(b, c)
A basic feasible solution to a m × n transportation problem is said to be non-degenerate if
(a) The total number of non-negative allocations is exactly m + n – 1.
(b) There m + n – 1 allocations are in independent position.
